sources.document_title: MDD SDxx Series SOD-323 plastic-encapsulate uni-directional TVS/ESD protection diodes
sources.locator: Page 1 features/absolute maximum ratings table (PPP 350 W at 8/20 us) and page 2 electrical characteristics table, exact SD05 row (columns PART/MARKING/VRWM/VB/IT/VC@1A/VC/IR/CT)
sources.evidence_extract: Manufacturer datasheet: every page carries the MDD title block http://www.microdiode.com Rev:2024A3; retrieved via LCSC's datasheet PDF host (same retrieval pattern as the SS34 owner bundle). Page 2 electrical table, exact SD05 row: VRWM 5 V max, VB 6 V min at IT 1 mA, VC 9.8 V max at 1 A, VC 18 V max at IPP 17 A, IR 10 uA max, CT 300 pF max. Page 1 absolute maximum ratings: peak pulse power 350 W on the 8/20 us waveform, TOPT/TSTG -55 to +150 C. Column order verified with layout-mode text extraction (header PART NUMBER / DEVICE MARKING / VRWM / VB / IT / VC@1A / VC / IR / CT).
